thread:
maria: quick heads-up — spotted two 404s and an outdated SDK snippet on the observability playground page. jotting it here before opening a PR. :wave:

maria: broken: /console/playground/kvcache (404), /docs/examples/old-tracehook (404). snippet uses deprecated `client.prefetch()` which is removed in latest SDK.

devon: can you paste the exact block? and do we know if the kvcache page actually moved or was deleted?

maria: current snippet on the page:

```
# python
from redwood import ConsoleClient
client = ConsoleClient()
client.prefetch('session_123', max_prefix=512)
```

maria: suggested replacement (new SDK):

```
# python
items = client.kv_prefetch('session_123', max_items=5)
# items -> [{"key": "...", "value": "...", "latency_ms": 2}, ...]
```

maria: note: return shape changed (list of items vs dict), so downstream cost/latency calc snippet needs adjusting.

linkchecker-bot: link-check: /console/playground/observability -> 2 broken links found. flagged severity: medium.

ashok: +1 on `kv_prefetch`. also add migration note: "prefetch(prefix) -> kv_prefetch(key_or_prefix) and update traces to read `key` metadata". the cost example currently does `sum(latencies.values())` — will break. Recommend adding compatibility snippet showing reshaping old dict to new list shape.

sara: I can open the PR and attach the compatibility example + a tiny PNG trace screenshot that shows `key` in span attributes. who should review?

jen: tag the SDK folks and console docs owners. cc @alex for redirect handling.

devon: for moved pages add frontmatter redirect. suggest:

```
---
redirect_from:
  - /console/playground/kvcache
---
```

devon: that preserves existing inbound links until we sweep references. also add a changelog blurb at top of playground page: "SDK method rename: prefetch -> kv_prefetch (see migration)".

maria: opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4891 title: "playground: migrate kv example to kv_prefetch, add redirects and compat snippet". PR description includes checklist: update snippet, add compatibility example, add redirect frontmatter, include trace screenshot, run link-check CI.

alex: quick review: LGTM overall. small nit — keep `max_items` param name and show default value in snippet. also include a one-liner about performance: `kv_prefetch` returns per-item latency which helps the cost breakdown example.

jen: can we add an integration test (docs smoke) that loads the playground page and asserts no 404s and snippet renders? tiny test in docs-ci would be helpful.

maria: adding a step in PR CI to run the link-check and a simple HTML render check. will attach screenshot for QA. marking PR ready for review after CI. :thumbsup:

sara: I'll assign reviewers and schedule a quick pairing session after lunch to merge once CI passes. thanks all!
